messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Random slopes model
parts:
Actually, the last model Ben sent will do the trick. If you change these lines

    intercept <- beta + u2_z[school[i]] * sigma_u2 ;
    slope <- gamma + v2_z[year[i]] * sigma_v2 ;

with

    slope <- gamma + v2_z[year[i]] * sigma_v2 ;
    intercept <- beta + u2_z[school[i]] * sigma_u2 ;

it compiles.

I haven't found the minimal model to show this behavior, but once we narrow it down, we should add it to our parser test.
